items.place: Chekkanurani police station, Madurai district, Tamil Nadu
items.headline: Lorry driver dies inside Madurai police station
items.text: R Balakrishnan, 42, held overnight over missing cardamom, was found hanging in Chekkanurani station's toilet on 14 Nov. Police say suicide; his family alleges foul play. Three police were suspended; CB-CID will investigate.

photo.alt: A city of low buildings and trees with four tall carved temple towers rising above the rooftops.
photo.caption: Madurai, with the towers of the Meenakshi temple, in 2006. File photo of the city.

items.place: Akhran-Amapora and nearby villages, Kulgam district, Jammu and Kashmir
items.headline: About 500 held or questioned in Kulgam
items.text: After an 11 Nov attack injured three CRPF personnel, forces have questioned or detained about 500 people in Kulgam; several were jailed under preventive laws. Police say they target militant support networks.

photo.alt: A wide stony riverbed with a shallow stream, wooded hills and a yellow-and-blue bridge railing in front.
photo.caption: The Vishaw river near Nihama, Kulgam district, in 2024. File photo of the district.

items.headline: Ukhrul families refuse bodies, seek NIA probe
items.text: Families of the four Tangkhul Naga civilians killed near New Haven refuse to claim the bodies until an NIA probe; a Naga body set a three-day ultimatum. The Chief Minister ordered continued combing operations.

photo.alt: A wide city of lit streets and buildings at dusk, with hills and a cloudy sky behind.
photo.caption: Imphal, Manipur's capital, at dusk in 2019. File photo of the city.

items.headline: Leh activists hold 24-hour hunger strike
items.text: About 40 Leh Apex Body activists fasted 24 hours on 14 Nov, seeking the report on the September 2025 police firing and deferral of 4 Dec council polls. The Centre reportedly offered talks 5–10 Dec.

photo.alt: A paved shopping street lined with two- and three-storey shops under prayer flags, with a bare brown mountain behind.
photo.caption: Main Bazaar Road in Leh, Ladakh, in 2018. File photo of the town.

items.headline: Man arrested over Yamuna dead-fish video
items.text: Delhi Police arrested a man over a 12 Nov video of dead fish at Wazirabad, on an irrigation department complaint alleging misinformation; he was bailed from the station. The fish deaths' cause is unconfirmed.

photo.alt: A long rusting steel truss bridge running over a river among trees, with a dirt path in front.
photo.caption: The Old Yamuna Bridge in Delhi, downstream of Wazirabad, in 2023. File photo of the river.

items.place: Supreme Court of India, New Delhi
items.headline: EC: dropped voters can re-enrol without prosecution
items.text: The Election Commission told the Supreme Court that voters left off SIR draft rolls can apply again on Form 6 without facing prosecution, if not enrolled elsewhere. The court has not ruled.

photo.alt: A domed red and cream building with an Indian flag, behind trees and a black statue on a pedestal.
photo.caption: The Supreme Court of India in New Delhi, which is hearing the electoral-roll case, in 2019.

items.headline: Relief group says RSF killed 10 in Al-Nuhud
items.text: A local emergency room says RSF fighters have killed 10 unarmed civilians in Al-Nuhud, West Kordofan, since Thursday, amid looting and a full telecoms blackout. The RSF has not commented.

photo.alt: A cream building with tall columns and a yellow Arabic sign, with a crowd of men standing outside.
photo.caption: The court complex in Al-Nuhud, West Kordofan, in 2013. File photo of the town.

items.place: Byar La displacement camp, Ponnagyun, Rakhine State, Myanmar
items.headline: Air strike on Rakhine camp kills up to 12
items.text: Rescuers say a military air strike on Byar La displacement camp, Ponnagyun, on Friday killed 12, a five-year-old among them, and injured 18; early reports said eight. The military could not be reached.

photo.alt: A wooden suspension bridge with red railings leading towards a wooded hill topped by a golden pagoda and a tall lift tower.
photo.caption: The Urittaung pagoda seen from the river bridge in Ponnagyun, Rakhine, in 2020. File photo of the town.

items.place: Lifembe, Walese Vonkutu, Irumu territory, Ituri, DR Congo
items.headline: Soldier accused of killing three in Irumu village
items.text: Civil society says an army soldier shot dead a woman, a farmer and a child under five in Lifembe, Irumu, on 11 Nov, and asks military justice to arrest him. The army has not commented.

photo.alt: Red-roofed houses, fields and dirt roads seen from a small plane over green hills.
photo.caption: Houses in Irumu territory, Ituri, seen from the air in 2023. File photo of the territory.

items.headline: Drone strike kills two in Jabaliya
items.text: Shifa Hospital says an Israeli drone killed two Palestinians walking in Jabaliya on Saturday. Israel's military says it struck two Hamas militants. Gaza's health ministry counts 1,600+ killed since the ceasefire.

photo.alt: Flattened concrete buildings and heaps of rubble under a blue sky, with damaged tower blocks behind.
photo.caption: Destroyed buildings in Jabaliya camp, northern Gaza, in October 2024.

items.place: Wadi Seif, Beit Fajjar, south of Bethlehem, West Bank
items.headline: Settlers injure five olive pickers near Beit Fajjar
items.text: WAFA says Israeli settlers attacked olive harvesters in Wadi Seif, near Beit Fajjar, on Saturday evening, moderately injuring five and smashing vehicles. Israel's military has not commented.

photo.alt: A gloved hand picking purple olives from a branch.
photo.caption: Olive picking near Dura in the Hebron governorate, southern West Bank, in 2020. File photo, not of Wadi Seif.
photo.credit: M sh شراونة محمد / Wikimedia Commons

items.place: Paris, Lyon and cities across France
items.headline: France protests: 219 arrested on fifth Saturday
items.text: 106,000 (interior ministry) to 200,000 (youth unions) marched across France on Saturday; police made 219 arrests by 6pm and fired tear gas in Lyon. The ministry says 10 officers were lightly hurt.

photo.alt: A bronze statue of a woman holding an olive branch on a tall stone monument, against a blue sky.
photo.caption: The Monument to the Republic at Place de la République, Paris, a usual rally point, in 2026.
